name: @soldock/dock
description: The Soldock Worker: the entire backend as one deployable.

scripts.deploy:check: wrangler deploy --dry-run --env development --outdir dist/development && wrangler deploy --dry-run --env rivus --outdir dist/rivus
scripts.migrate:development: wrangler d1 migrations apply DIRECTORY --remote --env development
scripts.migrate:rivus: wrangler d1 migrations apply DIRECTORY --remote --env rivus
